problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 17 different infrastructure projects to maximize the total projected benefit.  
The features of each project are as follows:  
* Project A: projected benefit is 0.111, impact score is 0.131, allocation bounds [0.099, 0.407]  
* Project B: projected benefit is 0.170, impact score is 0.057, allocation bounds [0.036, 0.313]  
* Project C: projected benefit is 0.175, impact score is 0.142, allocation bounds [0.007, 0.806]  
* Project D: projected benefit is 0.096, impact score is 0.239, allocation bounds [0.003, 0.846]  
* Project E: projected benefit is 0.055, impact score is 0.022, allocation bounds [0.012, 0.313]  
* Project F: projected benefit is 0.056, impact score is 0.074, allocation bounds [0.029, 0.706]  
* Project G: projected benefit is 0.184, impact score is 0.011, allocation bounds [0.019, 0.527]  
* Project H: projected benefit is 0.161, impact score is 0.075, allocation bounds [0.059, 0.772]  
* Project I: projected benefit is 0.081, impact score is 0.077, allocation bounds [0.077, 0.367]  
* Project J: projected benefit is 0.140, impact score is 0.191, allocation bounds [0.004, 0.862]  
* Project K: projected benefit is 0.145, impact score is 0.079, allocation bounds [0.003, 0.483]  
* Project L: projected benefit is 0.197, impact score is 0.223, allocation bounds [0.020, 0.444]  
* Project M: projected benefit is 0.128, impact score is 0.286, allocation bounds [0.017, 0.786]  
* Project N: projected benefit is 0.080, impact score is 0.106, allocation bounds [0.089, 0.697]  
* Project O: projected benefit is 0.124, impact score is 0.225, allocation bounds [0.072, 0.865]  
* Project P: projected benefit is 0.193, impact score is 0.070, allocation bounds [0.034, 0.886]  
* Project Q: projected benefit is 0.131, impact score is 0.063, allocation bounds [0.055, 0.899]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified bounds, and the sum of all budget shares must equal the total available budget.  
To ensure timely completion, the planner requires that the set of quick-delivery projects, represented by Q = {B, C, D, E, F, H, I, J, K, M, Q}, collectively receive at least 0.303 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the overall impact score of the portfolio must not exceed 0.141, and the total projected benefit must be at least 0.093.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total projected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
